description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and ship core backend features in a distributed systems codebase, owning reliability across several major cloud providers. Work directly with technical customers to help them close deals, and produce documentation and public-facing interfaces.
 What you'll do
 - Create the underlying platform pieces and scalable server-side logic, mainly in a low-level systems language.
 - Design for failure modes and edge cases across multiple cloud providers.
 - Move quickly by directing AI coding tools to accelerate delivery.
 - Partner with technical customers in shared chat channels to support their purchasing decisions.
 - Produce clear technical documentation and help shape public-facing interfaces and publicly shared code.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Experience at a developer infrastructure startup.
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 - Cloud engineering experience with major providers, container orchestration and relational databases.
 - Working knowledge of Rust or Go, with Rust preferred.
 - Self-motivated, with a drive to take ownership as part of a founding team.
 Bonus points
 - Experience as a founding engineer.
 - Experience maintaining or operating production systems at scale.
 - Familiarity with managed Kubernetes services.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 155,000 to 200,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Remote-friendly work environment
 Location and work model
 - Remote (US)
 - Full-time
